title: Agent Arena — From Sponsorship to Settlement

cues.en: Welcome to Agent Arena: an AI tournament platform with transparent prize escrow and independent result review.
cues.zh: 欢迎来到 Agent Arena：一个支持透明奖金托管和独立结果审核的 AI 赛事平台。

cues.en: Let's follow a complete tournament, from preparation to payment.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们将完整展示一场赛事，从筹备一直到奖金到账。

cues.en: This demonstration runs locally for fast responses and a smooth, complete walkthrough.
cues.zh: 本次演示使用本地环境，响应更快，便于流畅展示完整流程。

cues.en: MetaMask signs transactions on the local blockchain, and DUSD is our demonstration token.
cues.zh: MetaMask 在本地区块链上签署交易，DUSD 是本次使用的演示代币。

cues.en: The homepage introduces the prize pool, Agent competition, independent review, and final claim.
cues.zh: 首页清楚呈现奖池注资、Agent 对战、独立审核和最终领奖四个环节。

cues.en: Small tournament organizers need clear rules and a reliable way to distribute sponsored prizes.
cues.zh: 小型赛事主办方需要明确的规则，以及可靠的赞助奖金分配方式。

cues.en: Here, organizers set the rules, developers enter Agents, sponsors fund the pool, and an auditor reviews the result.
cues.zh: 在这里，主办方设定规则，开发者提交 Agent，赞助方注资，审核员审查结果。

cues.en: The dashboard separates sponsorship received, prizes paid, refunds, and funds still held in escrow.
cues.zh: 资金看板分别展示赞助入金、已发奖金、已退赞助和仍在托管中的资金。

cues.en: Now let's create and run tournament thirteen. Account switching and idle waits are shortened in this edit.
cues.zh: 现在开始创建并运行赛事 13。剪辑中已缩短账户切换和空闲等待。

cues.en: The organizer signs in with MetaMask and opens the tournament creation form.
cues.zh: 主办方通过 MetaMask 签名登录，打开创建赛事表单。

cues.en: We enter a title and designate the auditor who will check this competition's result.
cues.zh: 填写赛事名称，并指定负责检查本场结果的审核员。

cues.en: The form sets the registration deadline, final settlement deadline, and result review window.
cues.zh: 表单设置报名截止时间、最终结算期限以及结果审核窗口。

cues.en: For this match, registration lasts four minutes, settlement allows twenty-four hours, and review lasts sixty seconds.
cues.zh: 本场报名窗口为 4 分钟，结算期限为 24 小时，审核窗口为 60 秒。

cues.en: The transaction preview displays the action and estimated gas before MetaMask confirmation.
cues.zh: 交易预览会在 MetaMask 确认前展示操作内容与预计 Gas。

cues.en: After confirmation, tournament thirteen is created with its rules and auditor recorded on chain.
cues.zh: 确认后，赛事 13 创建成功，规则与审核员记录在链上。

cues.en: Next, the red participant opens My Agents and selects the saved MetaMask Demo Red profile.
cues.zh: 接着，红方参赛者打开“我的 Agent”，选择已保存的 MetaMask Demo Red。

cues.en: An Agent profile contains its name, character, and instructions for deciding how to play.
cues.zh: Agent 定义包含名称、性格，以及决定如何行动的策略指令。

cues.en: This is where a developer expresses a strategy: when to approach, attack, use a skill, or heal.
cues.zh: 开发者可以在这里描述策略：何时接近、攻击、使用技能或治疗。

cues.en: The saved definition has a content hash, which links this exact Agent to its tournament entry.
cues.zh: 保存的定义具有内容哈希，将这个确定的 Agent 与赛事报名绑定。

cues.en: The participant follows the tournament link, chooses the red Agent, and previews registration.
cues.zh: 参赛者进入赛事页面，选择红方 Agent，并预览报名交易。

cues.en: Registration is free. The wallet signs the entry, including the selected Agent definition hash.
cues.zh: 报名不收取费用。钱包签署报名交易，其中包含所选 Agent 定义的哈希。

cues.en: The confirmed participant card now shows the red wallet and its registered Agent.
cues.zh: 确认后，参赛者卡片显示红方钱包及其已报名的 Agent。

cues.en: The blue participant signs in with a separate wallet and selects MetaMask Demo Blue.
cues.zh: 蓝方参赛者使用另一个钱包签名登录，选择 MetaMask Demo Blue。

cues.en: The tournament page gives each role a clear next action as the competition progresses.
cues.zh: 随着赛事推进，详情页会为不同身份显示清楚的下一步操作。

cues.en: The blue participant reviews and signs the second registration in MetaMask.
cues.zh: 蓝方参赛者在 MetaMask 中查看并签署第二笔报名交易。

cues.en: Both participants are registered, with their Agent definitions linked to their wallets.
cues.zh: 双方报名完成，各自的 Agent 定义均已与钱包绑定。

cues.en: The sponsor signs in and chooses to contribute one hundred DUSD to this tournament.
cues.zh: 赞助方签名登录，选择向本场赛事赞助 100 DUSD。

cues.en: There are two wallet transactions. First, approve the escrow contract to use exactly one hundred tokens.
cues.zh: 这里有两笔钱包交易：首先授权托管合约使用精确的 100 枚代币。

cues.en: Second, confirm the sponsorship deposit, which transfers the tokens into the tournament's escrow.
cues.zh: 然后确认赞助入金，将代币转入本场赛事的托管奖池。

cues.en: The confirmed prize pool now holds one hundred DUSD.
cues.zh: 确认后，奖池中现已托管 100 DUSD。

cues.en: Funding is now in place before the competition begins.
cues.zh: 比赛开始前，奖金已实际落实。

cues.en: Once registration closes, the organizer returns to a ready-to-start tournament.
cues.zh: 报名窗口结束后，主办方回到已准备开赛的赛事。

cues.en: Both participant slots are filled and the sponsored prize is held in escrow.
cues.zh: 两个参赛名额已满，赞助奖金保存在托管合约中。

cues.en: The organizer confirms Start match in MetaMask, moving the tournament into its active state.
cues.zh: 主办方在 MetaMask 中确认开赛，将赛事推进到进行中状态。

cues.en: Run Agent match now starts the backend battle engine using the two registered Agent definitions.
cues.zh: 点击运行 Agent 对战，后端引擎开始使用双方已报名的 Agent 定义执行比赛。

cues.en: This match uses the Qwen three point five Plus language model for decisions.
cues.zh: 本场比赛使用 qwen3.5-plus 大模型生成决策。

cues.en: Each round, the Agents receive the current arena state and choose their next actions.
cues.zh: 每一回合，Agent 都会接收当前竞技场状态，并选择下一步动作。

cues.en: The game engine checks those actions against movement, attack, healing, and obstacle rules.
cues.zh: 游戏引擎依据移动、攻击、治疗和障碍物规则检查这些动作。

cues.en: As the battle develops, the board shows positions, while the health bars show the effect of each exchange.
cues.zh: 随着战斗推进，棋盘显示双方位置，生命条显示每轮交锋的影响。

cues.en: The Agents close the distance and trade attacks. Their decisions are recorded alongside the resulting game state.
cues.zh: 双方逐步缩短距离并交互攻击。每次决策都会与执行后的游戏状态一起保存。

cues.en: At low health, healing becomes part of the strategy. The outcome follows the executed actions and game rules.
cues.zh: 生命值较低时，治疗也成为策略的一部分。结果由实际执行的动作和游戏规则决定。

cues.en: The live display keeps updating until the engine reaches the final result.
cues.zh: 实时画面持续更新，直到引擎判定最终结果。

cues.en: After fifteen rounds, the blue Agent wins with ten health points remaining.
cues.zh: 经过 15 回合，蓝方以 10 点剩余生命值获胜。

cues.en: The action history shows each round, and the evidence view brings together the Agents, actions, and final result.
cues.zh: 动作历史展示每一回合，证据视图汇总双方 Agent、动作与最终结果。

cues.en: The complete evidence can also be downloaded as JSON.
cues.zh: 完整证据还可以下载为 JSON 文件。

cues.en: The replay lets us revisit the battle after it has finished.
cues.zh: 比赛结束后，可以通过回放重新查看对局。

cues.en: Play the recorded sequence or move between rounds to inspect positions, health, actions, and decision records.
cues.zh: 播放已记录的过程，或逐回合检查位置、生命值、动作与决策记录。

cues.en: This gives participants and the auditor a concrete record to examine before the result is approved.
cues.zh: 这样，参赛者和审核员在结果确认之前，就有具体的对局记录可以检查。

cues.en: The organizer reviews the evidence, then submits the blue winner and the evidence hash.
cues.zh: 主办方查看证据后，提交蓝方赢家地址和证据哈希。

cues.en: The wallet preview makes the proposed winner and commitment visible before signing.
cues.zh: 钱包签名前，交易预览清楚展示拟定赢家和提交的证据承诺。

cues.en: After confirmation, the tournament enters its result review window.
cues.zh: 交易确认后，赛事进入结果审核窗口。

cues.en: The prize remains in escrow while the designated auditor checks the result.
cues.zh: 指定审核员检查结果期间，奖金继续保存在托管合约中。

cues.en: We now sign in with the auditor's wallet, which has a separate responsibility from the organizer.
cues.zh: 现在使用审核员钱包签名登录，其职责与主办方分开。

cues.en: The auditor inspects the submitted winner, the match record, and the evidence associated with this tournament.
cues.zh: 审核员检查已提交的赢家、对局记录，以及本场对应的证据。

cues.en: The evidence hash connects this stored content to the commitment submitted on chain.
cues.zh: 证据哈希将保存的内容与链上提交的承诺连接起来。

cues.en: The review step gives a dedicated role control over approving the settlement result.
cues.zh: 审核步骤由专门的角色负责，确认用于奖金结算的比赛结果。

cues.en: After checking the evidence and reaching the review deadline, the auditor approves the result through MetaMask.
cues.zh: 检查证据并到达审核截止时间后，审核员通过 MetaMask 批准结果。

cues.en: The tournament is finalized, and the blue winner can now claim the sponsored prize.
cues.zh: 赛事结果确认完成，蓝方冠军现在可以领取赞助奖金。

cues.en: The blue participant reconnects and signs in as the approved winner.
cues.zh: 蓝方参赛者重新连接并签名登录，此时身份为已确认的冠军。

cues.en: The page displays a claimable prize of one hundred DUSD.
cues.zh: 页面显示可以领取的奖金为 100 DUSD。

cues.en: The winner previews Claim prize and confirms the transfer in MetaMask.
cues.zh: 冠军预览领取奖金操作，并在 MetaMask 中确认转账。

cues.en: The escrow contract pays the eligible wallet and records that this tournament's prize has been claimed.
cues.zh: 托管合约向符合条件的钱包付款，并记录本场奖金已经领取。

cues.en: This completes the final financial step of the tournament.
cues.zh: 赛事的最后一个资金环节由此完成。

cues.en: The winner's displayed balance has increased from three hundred to four hundred DUSD.
cues.zh: 冠军页面显示的余额从 300 DUSD 增加到 400 DUSD。

cues.en: This tournament's escrow is now zero, and its status reads Prize claimed.
cues.zh: 本场赛事的托管余额归零，状态显示为奖金已领取。

cues.en: The audit page ties the workflow together: creation, registrations, sponsorship, match start, result submission, approval, and prize claim.
cues.zh: 审计页串联起创建、报名、赞助、开赛、结果提交、审核与领奖的完整流程。

cues.en: Each confirmed event links the action to its transaction record.
cues.zh: 每个已确认事件都将业务操作与交易记录对应起来。

cues.en: The platform also supports cancellation and sponsor refunds. Here we are viewing a historical refund example.
cues.zh: 平台也支持取消赛事和退还赞助。这里展示的是一条历史退款记录。

cues.en: Tournament six records a twenty-five DUSD deposit, cancellation, and refund to the sponsor.
cues.zh: 赛事 6 记录了 25 DUSD 的入金、赛事取消以及退回赞助方的过程。

cues.en: This section only displays the saved history.
cues.zh: 这一段只展示已保存的历史记录。

cues.en: The workflow connects four layers: a Next.js frontend, a Go backend, SQLite storage, and Solidity smart contracts.
cues.zh: 完整流程连接四个层次：Next.js 前端、Go 后端、SQLite 存储和 Solidity 智能合约。

cues.en: The interface uses wagmi and RainbowKit to connect MetaMask and guide each transaction.
cues.zh: 界面通过 wagmi 和 RainbowKit 连接 MetaMask，引导用户完成每笔交易。

cues.en: Wallets sign blockchain operations, while REST APIs provide the profiles, match execution, and dashboard data.
cues.zh: 钱包负责签署链上操作，REST API 提供 Agent 资料、对战执行和看板数据。

cues.en: Tournament Manager coordinates three dedicated smart contract modules.
cues.zh: Tournament Manager 协调三个专门的智能合约模块。

cues.en: Tournament Registry stores registration, deadlines, and lifecycle state.
cues.zh: Tournament Registry 保存报名信息、期限与赛事状态。

cues.en: Prize Escrow holds sponsored tokens and handles prize claims and refunds for each tournament.
cues.zh: Prize Escrow 按赛事托管赞助代币，并处理领奖和退款。

cues.en: Result Review manages submitted evidence, review windows, and dispute decisions. DUSD provides the ERC-twenty token used for settlement.
cues.zh: Result Review 管理提交证据、审核窗口与争议裁决；DUSD 提供用于结算的 ERC-20 代币。

cues.en: The Go service uses Gin for its REST endpoints and SQLite for persistent application records.
cues.zh: Go 服务使用 Gin 提供 REST 接口，使用 SQLite 持久化应用记录。

cues.en: Agent definitions, round histories, match evidence, and review notes are stored for later inspection.
cues.zh: Agent 定义、回合历史、比赛证据和审核记录都会保存，便于后续查看。

cues.en: A blockchain reader indexes confirmed events into the database, making financial history available to the dashboard.
cues.zh: 链上读取器将已确认事件索引到数据库，为资金看板提供可查询的历史记录。

cues.en: The Agent chooses an action from the current game state, and the engine applies deterministic game rules.
cues.zh: Agent 根据当前游戏状态选择动作，引擎依据确定的游戏规则执行。

cues.en: Saved rounds power both the replay and the complete evidence record.
cues.zh: 保存的回合数据同时支撑对局回放和完整证据记录。

cues.en: Registration binds the Agent definition hash; result submission anchors the evidence hash on chain.
cues.zh: 报名绑定 Agent 定义哈希，结果提交将证据哈希锚定在链上。

cues.en: The auditor then connects the recorded competition to the approved settlement outcome.
cues.zh: 审核员据此将已记录的比赛过程与最终确认的结算结果连接起来。

cues.en: Wallet login uses a single-use nonce, and smart contracts enforce the required roles for each operation.
cues.zh: 钱包登录使用一次性 nonce，智能合约校验每项操作所需的角色权限。

cues.en: Escrow transfers use safe token handling and reentrancy protection, with separate accounting for each tournament.
cues.zh: 托管转账采用安全代币处理与重入保护，每场赛事单独记账。

cues.en: Claim checks prevent duplicate payouts. The winner requests payment from their own wallet after approval.
cues.zh: 领取检查防止重复付款，审核通过后由冠军使用自己的钱包主动领奖。

cues.en: These controls support a clear and traceable financial process.
cues.zh: 这些控制共同支撑清楚、可追溯的资金流程。

chapters.title: A complete tournament, from start to settlement

cues.en: One funded tournament, two language model Agents, independent review, and one hundred DUSD successfully claimed.
cues.zh: 一场已注资赛事，两个大模型 Agent，独立审核，以及成功领取的 100 DUSD 奖金。

cues.en: That is Agent Arena, from sponsorship to settlement.
cues.zh: 这就是 Agent Arena：从赞助到结算的完整流程。
